full_judgment:
11. Mr. Khandker Mahbub Hossain, the learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the condemned-prisoner-appellant makes his submissions opposing the reference and supporting the criminal appeal. He submits that the accused explained the death of the deceased as due to suicidal hanging. The presence of an oblique uncontinuous ligature markon the neck of the dead body of the deceased supports such explanation of the death of the deceased by suicidal hanging. There is no finding of the Medical Board, who held autopsy that the ligature mark on the neck of the deceased was post mortem one. It is the medical evidence that there was only one simple haematoma on the occipital region of the head of the deceased. Neither the skull under that haematomanor the meanings or the brain was injured. Such simple injury like haematoma on the occipital region cannot be the cause of death. According to the medical evidence death was due to cerebral failure which is the cause of all death. Dr. Shahidul Islam who actually held post mortem examination of the dead body of the deceased was withheld without explanation. The medical evidence of PW 7, who was not present at the time of post mortem examination of the deceased is not credible. There is serious doubt as to the cause of death of the deceased. Thus the prosecution failed to prove beyond all reasonable doubt that the deceased was assaulted to death and an offence or murder of the deceased was committed. He further urges that the prosecution intentionally withheld the domestic helps of the accused and others, who in their statements recorded on the date of occurrence under section 161 of the Code of Criminal procedure in the Unnatural Death Case and subsequently in the murder case and also recorded under section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure by the magistrate supported the defence version that the deceased committed suicide by hanging. Those witnesses were fully aware of what actually happened and as such they are material witnesses. Due to non-examination of those material witnesses without explanation presumption under section under section 114(g) of the Evidence Act would be that had they been examined they would not have supported the prosecution case and makes the prosecution case doubtful. Mr. Khandker further submits that as there is serious doubt as to the cause of death of the deceased, as benefit of such doubt the accused is entitled to get acquittal. The Court below wrongly convicted and sentenced him. Therefore, the impugned judgment and order of conviction and sentence is not sustainable. Thus he canvasses for rejection of the reference, allowing the appeal and acquittal of the condemned-prisoner-appellant. 

 51. In the instant case the accused failed to discharge his such obligation. The certified copies of the statements under sections.161 and 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure of the maids and others of the house of the accused filed by the accused at the time of examination under section 342 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in support of his case that the deceased committed suicide by hanging are not evidence and, as such, cannot be considered. There is no evidence that the deceased committed suicide by hanging. Moreover, the accused's explanation that the deceased committed suicide by hanging has been proved untrue. It is proved beyond doubt that the deceased was done to death. There is nothing to hold that anybody else besides the accused could cause the death of the deceased. So in view of the above settled principle of law inevitable inference would be that the accused is responsible for the death of his deceased wife. None but he intentionally caused her death and thereby committed the offence of murder. Thus non-examination of the maids, driver and security guards of the house of the accused and the key maker is not fatal for the prosecution in the above facts and circumstance of the present case. It cannot be expected that they will give evidence against the accused. Moreover the accused in order to discharge his obligation could examine them. All of them are his men. But he did not do so. So no adverse presumption against the prosecution should be drawn for their non-examination by the prosecution.
